name: China National Tea Corporation
notableMarks: Blue Seal Green Label (蓝印绿标)
description: State tea trading corporation whose Zhong Cha trademark, the eight-pointed 'zhong' character in a red circle, appeared on pu-erh produced by multiple state-run and later privatized Yunnan factories across decades. The colored-seal classifications (Red Seal, Blue Seal) it used to grade production batches are among the most collected designations in pu-erh history.
